description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Smartsheet sheet. Smartsheet has no native upsert/column-match endpoint, so the resource fetches the sheet once, matches rows client-side on key_column, and routes each incoming row to a batched PUT (update) or POST (add), chunked at Smartsheet's 500-rows-per-call limit.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Smartsheet row (upserted via client-side match on key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Smartsheet.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Smartsheet column title used as the upsert match key. Must be present in fields_map's values.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). Hard-capped at 500 -- Smartsheet's row-add/row-update endpoints each accept at most 500 rows per API call.

name: Smartsheet Row Upsert
